blurb: Step into history at Hubbell Trading Post National Historic Site, the oldest continuously operating trading post in the Navajo Nation. Since 1878, this historic post in northeastern Arizona has been a center of commerce and cultural exchange. Today, visitors can walk through the original trading post, browse authentic Navajo rugs and crafts, and explore the historic homestead and barn.
